aggregation: Native baseline rows unchanged; other rows equal-weight arithmetic mean over BM25, Vector, SkillSight. Dataset Average task-weighted within each retriever, then equal-weight across retrievers.

metric_transformations.justification: Binary relevance and nonempty gold sets: DCG@1 is the top-ranked relevance indicator and IDCG@1=1. Thus per-task nDCG@1 equals Hit@1, and identical task-weighted means preserve equality.

vector_native_baseline.source: Fixed-run raw Vector retrieval, retained unchanged by the final/initial refresh.
